facts.text: The PhenixImager feature controls a PerkinElmer Opera Phenix high-content screening imager through its RCI (Remote Control Interface) protocol.
Stop is an unobservable command that stops the currently running acquisition protocol.
GoStandby takes DurationSeconds, an Integer with MinimalInclusive 60.
RunAcquisitionProtocol is observable; TimeoutMinutes is an Integer from 1 to 1440 (default 600 in its description) and ProgressInfo is its intermediate response.
DeviceState is a String property: Operate, Idle, Standby, Offline or Service.
StagePosition is a String property: Transfer, Operate, Service or Home.
StageMotionTimeout means that stage movement did not complete within 2 minutes.
PhenixImagerImpl starts with _simulation_mode set to True.
In real mode, get_DeviceState returns the device_state name of the transport status, or Offline when there is no status.
The RCI receive callback stores the status of every PROGRESS and STATUS reply in _status.
_require_connected raises NotConnected when the instrument is not connected.
Disconnect requires only a connection; in simulation mode it clears the connection, sets Offline and empties the protocol list.
Stop first requires a connection; in real mode it then calls the transport send_stop without an argument and returns.
send_stop sends the RCI STOP command with a barcode that defaults to an empty string.
_send_command waits up to COMMAND_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_S for a response and raises TimeoutError when none arrives.
_send_command_expect_ack checks only whether the reply is a REJECT; any other reply passes.
A real acquisition waits for a completion event that only a progress of 100 or more sets, for up to TimeoutMinutes, and sends EJECT only afterwards.
The transport reaches the instrument on port 8213 and listens for callbacks on port 8300.
COMMAND_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_S is 20.0 and STAGE_MOTION_TIMEOUT_S is 120.0.
connect creates the COM object RCI_DEVICELib.RCIDeviceClass through comtypes.client.
The phenix_imager server is the PerkinElmer Opera Phenix RCI wrapper (comtypes) on port 50058.
All servers start in simulation mode by default; the SimulationController feature switches to real mode.

safe_state.description: No acquisition running, proven only by the controlled peer: after Stop, a fresh authoritative observation must show no active execution. A native Phenix gives no such proof: its Stop is an acknowledged RCI STOP, DeviceState is a cached status, and the stage is ejected only after a completed run (facts.md); the stage position and the plate are left where they were.
